prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 2 (Advantages vs. Disadvantages) / 论文设计权衡（Trade-off）段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。”。请严格按照 `BP38` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L008`（先让步、再釜底抽薪式反驳（Concession-Pivot-Refutation）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Every coin has two sides. Although open-source AI has some security risks, it also has many advantages like helping researchers and small companies. So I think the advantages are bigger than the disadvantages.
structural_constraints: S1 [权衡定性主题句 Asymmetry Thesis]：Weighing both dimensions reveals that the long-term structural benefits of [X] far outweigh its manageable transitional costs.

S2 [将弊端限定为可收敛成本 Bounding the Drawback]：While [Drawback A, e.g., initial capital outlay / training overhead] poses a tangible hurdle, this cost is bounded and diminishes rapidly as [Mitigating Factor, e.g., hardware amortization / open-source standardization] matures.

S3 [凸显优势的不可替代性 Highlighting Irreversible Gain]：By contrast, the core advantage—[Benefit B, e.g., eliminating human exposure to hazardous environments / discovering non-linear scientific laws]—delivers compounding value that manual methods cannot replicate at any cost.
S4 [权衡结论 Trade-off Verdict]：Therefore, addressing the friction through targeted safeguards is far more rational than forgoing the transformative gain.

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文或科研立项书中，通过严密的“反事实推演（If we fail to... / Absent X...）”强化紧迫感与说服力。

source_material_or_draft: When the robot hand blocks the camera, the robot cannot see the object clearly. So we add force sensors and joint angles. Also, we predict multiple steps of actions and use an adapter to transfer from simulation to the real robot.

domain_context: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task1_Static 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT14 (雅思小作文（Task 1）静态柱状图与饼图组合满分范文：云端推理与机载机器人控制系统的能耗结构对比)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP25 -> BP27 -> BP28`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Every coin has two sides. Although open-source AI has some security risks, it also has many advantages like helping researchers and small companies. So I think the advantages are bigger than the disadvantages.
structural_constraints: S1 [权衡定性主题句 Asymmetry Thesis]：Weighing both dimensions reveals that the long-term structural benefits of [X] far outweigh its manageable transitional costs.

S2 [将弊端限定为可收敛成本 Bounding the Drawback]：While [Drawback A, e.g., initial capital outlay / training overhead] poses a tangible hurdle, this cost is bounded and diminishes rapidly as [Mitigating Factor, e.g., hardware amortization / open-source standardization] matures.

S3 [凸显优势的不可替代性 Highlighting Irreversible Gain]：By contrast, the core advantage—[Benefit B, e.g., eliminating human exposure to hazardous environments / discovering non-linear scientific laws]—delivers compounding value that manual methods cannot replicate at any cost.
S4 [权衡结论 Trade-off Verdict]：Therefore, addressing the friction through targeted safeguards is far more rational than forgoing the transformative gain.
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 深化论证段，或论文 Motivation 强化段
domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文或科研立项书中，通过严密的“反事实推演（If we fail to... / Absent X...）”强化紧迫感与说服力。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP39` 与全文样板 `FT14` 的后半部分（``），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: When the robot hand blocks the camera, the robot cannot see the object clearly. So we add force sensors and joint angles. Also, we predict multiple steps of actions and use an adapter to transfer from simulation to the real robot.
structural_constraints: S1 [正面基准命题 Positive Baseline]：Maintaining rigorous [Principle/Standard X] serves as the primary safeguard against [Systemic Risk Y].
S2 [反事实假设切入 Counterfactual Premise]：Absent this safeguard—if [Actors] were to rely exclusively on [Unchecked Alternative]—[Immediate Vulnerability] would quickly emerge.
S3 [连锁恶化传导 Cascading Deterioration]：Once [Immediate Vulnerability] takes hold, [Secondary Consequence] compounds across cycles, eventually eroding [Core Foundation].
S4 [实证印证或结论锁定 Empirical Echo]：This degradation dynamic mirrors [Real-world/Technical Precedent], underscoring why [Principle X] cannot be compromised for short-term convenience.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
